According to the documentation, **Hermes automatically passes `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}`** to OpenAI-compatible endpoints to track token usage for `/usage`. 

You do not need to manually configure `extra_body` or inject `stream_options`. Ensure your provider configuration is explicitly set as an OpenAI-compatible custom endpoint rather than relying on auto-detection:

```yaml
model:
  default: <model-name>
  provider: custom
  base_url: https://localai.example.internal/v1
fallback_providers: []
```

*(Note: If `/usage` still reports zero despite setting `provider: custom`, check if your provider type is recognized as an OpenAI-compatible endpoint in your config, as custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints should automatically receive the flag.)*
